affected_system: affordable housing production, preservation, subsidy, and compliance system
alternatives: rank verified high-consequence candidates for affordable-housing preservation and development portfolio
select a risk-, equity-, and lifecycle-balanced portfolio for affordable-housing preservation and development portfolio
pair unit-year, equity, access, risk, and subsidy portfolio optimization with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Units, affordability restrictions, occupancy, financing, condition, pipeline, and parcel feasibility are reconciled.
Modeled development feasibility is not treated as entitlement, financing close, or completed housing.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: fund only already-committed work for affordable-housing preservation and development portfolio.

constraints.description: The affordable housing siting and preservation prioritize must respect declared capital, operating, maintenance, and delivery budgets.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: housing development commissioner and affordable-housing finance director
decision_question: Which preservation, acquisition, rehabilitation, and new-development projects should receive funding?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The affordable housing siting and preservation prioritize must respect declared capital, operating, maintenance, and delivery budgets.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for affordable-housing preservation and development portfolio passes documented checks for cost, benefit, service life, dependencies, deliverability, and maintenance burden.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: unit-year, equity, access, risk, and subsidy portfolio optimization
independence_key.primary_outcome: affordable home-years lost relative to targets

intended_claim: A versioned prioritize design for comparing declared alternatives affecting affordable-housing preservation and development portfolio, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: affordable home-years lost relative to targets
distributional gap in affordable home-years lost relative to targets
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not report selected projects as financed, constructed, occupied, or preserved.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for affordable-housing preservation and development portfolio passes documented checks for cost, benefit, service life, dependencies, deliverability, and maintenance burden.

title: Prioritize affordable-housing preservation and development
transportability_risks: Land law, subsidy programs, construction costs, finance, tenant protections, and markets differ.
Observed transactions may omit informal displacement and off-market preservation risks.
